output.brief: The drop is most likely caused by the Finance credit-limit change FC-0417, which went live on 14 April. It cut the amount an agent can credit on a call from £100 to £25 and automatically sends larger billing cases to Billing Resolution. Billing referrals jumped from 7% to 54% that same week. Referred calls rarely resolve in one call (about 33%), while non-referred calls stayed at 82%, so the referral surge explains the fall in site FCR. The April intake is not the cause: tenured agents dropped by the same amount, and their referral rates match the new agents'. The IVR change came after the drop had already started, and the tariff rise does not explain it either. Confidence is moderate: the referral link is strong, but nobody has yet tested the credit change directly. Next steps: do not put new starters on performance plans, and do not restore the full credit limit at once. Instead, run a two-team trial of a revised in-call credit authority with post-call sampling, as Finance's controller suggested, and track FCR and unsupported credits. Ask MI to add contact reason and referral status to the dashboard.
